name: River Development Agent Production Governed Operation Execution Authorization Orchestration Integration
objective: Establish a deterministic non-executing orchestration boundary that invokes the existing DEV-318 authorization-consumption integration exactly once, observes the acquisition-and-consumption result already composed through DEV-317, and determines whether governed authorization may progress toward the existing operational executor entry boundary.
requirements: Invoke the DEV-318 governed operation-execution authorization consumption integration exactly once.
Do not directly invoke DEV-317 from DEV-319 because DEV-318 already performs deterministic DEV-317 authorization acquisition internally.
Observe DEV-318 authorizationAcquired and authorizationUsableForOperationalEntry without duplicating acquisition or consumption logic.
Preserve the authorization object exposed by DEV-318 when it is usable for operational entry.
Fail closed when DEV-318 does not expose authorization usable for operational entry.
Return an explicit deterministic orchestration state describing whether authorization is ready to be presented to the existing operational executor entry boundary.
Distinguish an authorization-ready result from a fail-closed authorization-blocked result.
Requested apply mode must never itself create, upgrade, synthesize, infer, or broaden authorization.
Do not execute repository mutation, package execution, command execution, commit, push, deployment, or any other operational side effect.
Do not call the DEV-314 operational executor integration entry boundary in DEV-319.
Do not bypass or weaken the DEV-314 operational executor integration entry authorization boundary.
Do not modify production callers in DEV-319.
Do not modify DEV-317 or DEV-318 implementation contracts.
Add focused tests proving one-time DEV-318 orchestration, authorization-ready behavior, fail-closed blocked behavior, deterministic propagation, and non-executing safety.
qualityGates: Existing River Dev baseline tests pass.
Repository diff is limited exactly to DEV-319 allowed paths.
DEV-319 contains no direct DEV-317 invocation.
DEV-319 contains exactly one DEV-318 consumption invocation.
No operation execution side effect is introduced.
No autonomous push or deployment behavior is introduced.
outOfScope: Broad refactoring unrelated to the DEV-319 orchestration boundary.
